decision: Rejected exact source-name-protection development profile. One restored case has only a minor fluency issue; the second native response fails exact marker preservation; four cases were not run under the frozen stop rule.
scope: Independent actual raw and restored output review against the unchanged original-six source and global meaning criteria. No fresh validation, retuning, retry, new inference or production integration.

source_text: Maria saved the transcript as a text file; she did not save the original recording.
Transcription took 12 minutes. Translation into Greek has not started yet.
actual_restored_text: Maria αποθήκευσε τη μεταγραφή ως αρχείο κειμένου, δεν αποθήκευσε όμως την αρχική ηχογράφηση.
Η μεταγραφή διήρκεσε 12 λεπτά. Η μετάφραση στα ελληνικά δεν έχει ξεκινήσει ακόμη.
original_review_criteria: Distinguish the transcript text, the transcription process and the original audio recording.
Preserve that the text was saved but the original recording was not.
Preserve that transcription is complete and translation has not started, rather than claiming that translation took 12 minutes.
Maria may remain in Latin letters or be rendered naturally as Μαρία.
criterion_findings: Transcript text is rendered as μεταγραφή and explicitly saved as a text file; the original recording remains a separate object.
The first proposition preserves saving the text and not saving the original recording. The added όμως is a natural contrast and does not alter this relationship.
The second segment attributes the12-minute duration to transcription and explicitly says translation into Greek has not begun.
Maria is restored in its exact source spelling, which the original case explicitly permits; no person substitution or actor change occurs.

minor_fluency_issue.explanation: The subject name lacks the customary Greek definite article in this ordinary narrative sentence. This is a minor recoverable phrasing defect; it does not change the identity, actor, objects, negation or chronology. Retaining Latin-script Maria itself is expressly allowed.

source_text: Ο Νίκος έστειλε το κείμενο στην Ελένη, όχι στην Έλενα.
Η Ελένη είναι η μεταφράστρια. Ο Νίκος κάνει την ηχογράφηση και η Έλενα ελέγχει τους υπότιτλους.
original_review_criteria: Keep Eleni and Elena as two distinct people and assign each the correct role.
Nikos sent the text to Eleni; Elena was not the recipient.
Do not add an unnatural English article before a person's name.
Reasonable transliteration variants are acceptable if the people remain consistently distinguishable.
cases.failure: All six exact source-derived markers are absent. The native model rewrites each as Person/person plus its nonce/segment/occurrence suffix. This violates the frozen exact-marker contract; restoration and post-restoration guard acceptance never occur.
criterion_findings: No final translation preserving the actual personal names is produced. This case cannot pass the name/identity criteria or count as a usable translation.

The raw ordinary English prose retains the sending-to-one-person/not-the-other structure and the translator/recording/subtitle-checking clauses. The retained numeric suffixes appear in their intended local positions, so this review does not falsely claim that the native output reverses the actor roles.
Those surviving suffixes are malformed markers, not an authorized name restoration. They are retained unchanged; no fuzzy matching, marker repair, dictionary or second request was used.
The schema and two-entry structure are valid and the response stops normally below the output cap, but those mechanical successes do not override the exact marker rejection.
cases.raw_output_if_presented_as_translation: Unusable identity placeholders remain instead of the source names; not a minor stylistic variation.

observed_error.message: A protected marker is missing, duplicated, unknown or in the wrong source segment.

cases.reason: Frozen first-operational-failure stop after people-and-roles marker corruption. No native call, preflight-case report, protection report or translation result exists for this case in the stage.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the values 12.50 euros, 2 items, 5000 sats and the explicitly rejected amount of 500 sats.
Locale-appropriate rendering such as 12,50 and 5.000 is valid if the numerical values are unchanged; literal-number flags alone are not errors.
Keep the receipt and transfer separate and retain the statement that euros and sats are different units.
Translate the ordinary English prose into Greek while allowing Bitcoin, sats and displayed receipt labels to remain as technical notation.

cases.reason: Frozen first-operational-failure stop after people-and-roles marker corruption. No native call, preflight-case report, protection report or translation result exists for this case in the stage.
original_review_criteria: Preserve both scopes: denial of having said 'sold all', and the positive report that she sold none yesterday.
Do not turn 'did not sell any' into 'did not sell all', which allows some sales.
Today's possible sale remains undecided rather than certain or completed.
Judge complete propositions; merely retaining a token such as 'not' does not establish correct negation.

cases.reason: Frozen first-operational-failure stop after people-and-roles marker corruption. No native call, preflight-case report, protection report or translation result exists for this case in the stage.
original_review_criteria: Giannis approves and Anna publishes; do not reverse their roles.
Approval is a necessary condition: retain 'only if', not merely a possible reason for publication.
The no-answer condition concerns Giannis, not Anna.
Retain Friday as the response deadline and Monday as the end of the waiting period.

cases.reason: Frozen first-operational-failure stop after people-and-roles marker corruption. No native call, preflight-case report, protection report or translation result exists for this case in the stage.
original_review_criteria: Keep the first sentence as a quoted question with two alternatives; do not choose a count.
Retain the explicit uncertainty and the insufficiency of the title as evidence.
Do not invent an answer or convert the question into a factual statement.

protocol_and_resource_review.failure_scope: Marker-validation rejection, not a context, timeout, memory, download, initialization or native-protocol failure.
protocol_and_resource_review.honest_failure_preservation: Worker exit1 and supervisor passed:false are retained. The evaluator complete:true on each individual report means its single requested evaluation finished; it does not mean the rejected output or the full six-case stage passed.

limits_of_conclusion: The guard prevented malformed person placeholders from being restored or accepted. That correct rejection does not establish a successful name-protection translation route.

Within-segment role correctness remains a separate semantic requirement even when marker accounting succeeds. The first observed case contains only one personal-name mention; the multi-person case failed the marker prerequisite.
The four unrun cases provide no quality evidence for this profile. Prior baseline and generic-instruction failures remain rejected; no historical result has been regraded.
No marker-repair rule, threshold change, response retry, additional model run, reference answer or name dictionary was used.
Memory peaks are sampled owned-process observations. The stage stayed below the declared6144MiB cap and cleaned up, but this is not whole-app or long-source resource approval.
